key.name: dictation-shortcut
key.description: Hold it to dictate; tap it to toggle hands-free dictation.

key.name: mode
key.description: auto: hold the modifier to dictate, tap to toggle. hold: release always stops. toggle: the shortcut starts and stops.

key.name: tap-ms
key.description: Releasing the modifier within this many milliseconds counts as a tap (toggle mode).

key.name: silence-stop-s
key.description: In hands-free mode, stop after this many seconds of silence. 0 = never.

key.name: microphone
key.description: PipeWire node name of the microphone to record from. Empty = the system default input.

key.name: polish
key.description: Send each finished block through Ollama to fix punctuation and casing. Off = pure offline recognition.

key.name: polish-model
key.description: Model name as listed by `ollama list`.

key.name: polish-url
key.description: Base URL of the Ollama server.

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Show an icon and menu in the GNOME Shell top bar.

key.name: show-hud
key.description: Show the microphone level and live text next to the cursor while dictating.
